principles: Port behavior, not stale lifecycle metadata.
Preserve proof-or-stop blockers for true material/source changes.
Keep the patch narrow enough to validate under current main.
drivers: Current local main lacks B-9dfb behavior while alternate history contains a verified implementation.
Hosts lose time when Lattice metadata-only dirty state blocks done_prepare at cleanTree.
Directly merging alternate main would import unrelated history.

options.name: B: Merge orchestrate/main
cons: May conflict with current active stories

options.name: C: Recreate old B-9dfb worktree
cons: Resolver already shows broken worktree binding
Would fight Lattice lifecycle metadata instead of fixing current main

rationale: Choose a fresh semantic port because the desired asset is the behavior and regression coverage, not the old stale story binding or the alternate-main commit graph.

preMortem.scenario: Patch is applied too broadly and imports stale B-9dfb story metadata.
preMortem.trigger: Using git cherry-pick or checkout without path filtering.
preMortem.consequence: Current story index gets polluted or duplicate lifecycle state appears.
preMortem.mitigation: Only edit the six allowed target files and keep .lattice/story/actives/B-9dfb excluded.

preMortem.scenario: Metadata-only allowance accidentally permits source changes.
preMortem.trigger: Dirty classification checks only destination path or ignores rename original path.
preMortem.consequence: done_prepare could mutate with uncommitted material changes present.
preMortem.mitigation: Require every dirty entry path/originalPath to classify as Lattice story metadata and add source/rename blocker smokes.

preMortem.trigger: Missing done_prepare report becomes non-blocking even when DONE oracle rows have blockers.
preMortem.consequence: Host receives a false localReady signal.
preMortem.mitigation: Make advisory status conditional on no DONE oracle blockers and cover with ready fixture smoke.
